requisitionList.Title: 36002886 - Artisan (Roads And Stormwater)
requisitionList.ShortDescriptionStr:
Co-ordinates and undertakes specialized/ technical civil construction trade work associated with 
controlling the operations pertaining to Road and Stormwater.

items.Title: 36002886 - Artisan (Roads And Stormwater)
items.ExternalDescriptionStr:
Key Responsibility Areas

  • Interprets and co-ordinates specific pre-work/ site requirements associated with repairs and planned, predictive maintenance.
  • Controls personnel, performance, productivity and discipline. 
  • Executes specialized/ trade related tasks and monitors and evaluates progress with regards to road and storm-water construction, repair and maintenance work.
  • Interacts and provides activity related information with regards to the works. 
  • Performs specific tasks associated with the operation of heavy and/or specialized vehicles (Tip trucks, Crane trucks, Vector etc.) during road and storm-water drainage maintenance activities. 
  • Performs specific administrative tasks/ activities associated with the updating and maintain records/ information related to the activities/ operations.

 

Competencies

  • Managing Work 
  • Planning & Organizing 
  • Workplace safety
  • Discipline Specific Skills 
  • Service Delivery Orientation 
  • Communication • Accountability & Ethical Conduct 
  • Learning Orientation
  • Team Orientation
  • Couching & Monitoring

 

 Essential Requirements 

  • Trade Tested Artisan in the Civil Construction industry or equivalent. 
  • Valid motor vehicle driving license (Code C1). 
  • Valid Professional Driving Permit (PrDP). 
  • Valid certification of competency in the operation of truck mounted cranes or to be obtained within 6 months from the date of appointment.
  • Certification in Basic First Aid to be completed within 6 months from date of appointment. 
  • 3 years relevant post apprenticeship experience. 

 

Special Conditions 

  • Required to work in all weather conditions. 
  • Required to work outside normal working hours during emergencies and planned overtime. 
  1. Required to be on stand-by duty.
